moments.text: Black-and-white infrared view over a streaky grey surface, darker at centre. A faint white dot drifts close to the crosshair.
The streaks give way to softer grey shading; the white dot grows clearer as the sensor keeps it near the crosshair.
A blue box opens around the crosshair, labelled 13M; the dot crosses from right to left inside it, then up onto the crosshair.
The box turns into corner brackets that shrink onto the dot as the label counts down 13M, 7M, 5M, 4M.
The dot, now bright, stays on the crosshair with a small blue marker beside it.
A second white dot enters at the right edge near the top and slides left along the top edge, gone in about 1.4 s.
The first dot slides off the crosshair down and right, its blue marker labelled 1M, and leaves through the bottom edge.
Another white dot drops in from the top edge left of centre; the sensor swings after it as it sweeps back and forth.
The dot keeps swinging, up to the top of the frame and back down the left side, as the sensor hunts for it.
The sensor settles with this dot close to the crosshair; streaks return to the background and the dot grows fainter toward the end.

notes: No black bars; redaction boxes over HUD. A fixed dark pixel sits lower right of the crosshair throughout (sensor artefact).
